role: the artifact door's jurisdiction — which files are records of truth
why: A record of truth is one whose WHO matters: a ticket's cursor, a trouble's clearance, a component's state and history, a proof's seal, a ruling. Ticket 30531f6e1c5d. The set is DECLARED here, once, and read by the door, the pre-commit check, and the PreToolUse gate — one spelling (Law 1). It grows by editing this file through the door like any other record; the rename ticket collapses it to one extension.

CairnCommons.resolves: the sibling of the cairn repo named CairnCommons (cairn/tools/base/address.py: ROOTS['commons'])

cairn.resolves: the repo this file lives in (cairn/tools/base/address.py: ROOTS['repo'])

not_records: intentions-congruency-lab/ is DERIVED (regenerated by the compiler, never authored); node_classes/, notes/, learning/, measurements/ are authored spec and prose whose who is the commit author — they enter when the rename ticket gives them the extension. Proof fixtures never sit under these names in git; a proof that needs a world hands the door a scratch root through set_diagnostic_roots.
